figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Biological activities of compound 1. (A) The effect on
adiponectin production during adipogenesis in hBM-MSCs. Com-
pound 1 was added to the IDX medium during the adipogenesis
induction. Adiponectin in cell culture supernatants was measured
using ELISA. Aspirin (ASA) and glibenclamide (GLI) were used as
positive control drugs. (B) Concentration dependence of 1, ASA, and
GLI. (C) The antimelanogenic effect of 1 in the human melanoma
MNT-1 cell line. MNT-1 cells treated with 1 and melanogenesis
inhibitors were harvested on the sixth day after treatment, and the
melanin content was quantified by measuring absorbance at 490 nm.
(D) Concentration dependency of 1 against melanogenesis. The
values represent the mean expression level ± SD (n = 3): *p <0.05;
**p <0.01.
